author: Gamers Nexus
description:
Sponsor: Montech TEN mATX PC Case https://geni.us/eoAoo
We're joined by Wendell of Level1 Techs to discuss the future of I/O, PCIe, homelab, DIY servers, and second-hand / used parts from the enterprise market. We cover home and small business networking options, PCIe carriers and cards, adapters, oddities, and other fun technology that Wendell has lying around his labrynthian office.

Find Wendell here! https://www.youtube.com/c/level1techs

Watch our prior installments in this series:

The Future is PCIE - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5Fz3P41emo8
